text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, Verxina and Gentildonna
were running side by side.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... I couldn't reach you again.
...I was completely... outmatched, wasn't I?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"……Does it really take you that long
to find words to say to a loser……?"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...No. For a moment—
I was just surprised that you managed to get ahead of me.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Shouldn't we make our training much harder
so that I won't be overpowered by her?!
choice_data_list: ...There are other ways to deal with this.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Using weight shifting and proper footwork effectively...
like this?"
choice_data_list: Right! It's all about softness overcoming hardness.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...I see. If used well,
it might allow one to deal with any formidable opponent—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: So she was using those teachings unconsciously...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Sounds like you had a fortuitous encounter.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(It was just for a moment, but I outdueled her...!
If I keep this up and work hard with Trainer—)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Heh, just you wait.
At this rate, I shall completely overwhelm them next time!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...I shall look forward to it, then.
